action_items: Main agent: keep Stripe environment setup task tracked externally; /api/billing/create-checkout-session auth gate works, and Stripe checkout creation remains configuration-dependent (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY).

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while platform guidance mentions EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Current env is aligned with code and works, but standardize naming across docs/code to avoid future misconfiguration.
In /api/billing/create-checkout-session, return_url defaults to a hardcoded preview URL if client does not pass one; consider using environment-driven default for deployment portability.
